scientific_integrity: Analytic proof and separately reproducible standard-library integer-arithmetic checks. Unindexed equivalent literature remains a residual originality risk. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Proves diagonal numerator root counts for the integer pairs (m,n)=(2n+1,n), n>=1, only; does not resolve the conjecture for arbitrary rational slopes, prove simplicity, or classify all off-diagonal Bergman-kernel zeros. The finite checker corroborates exact coefficients; the infinite theorem rests on the symbolic proof.
title: A Fejér certificate for the slope-two Hartogs diagonal
